vo_title_welcome.speaker: Sarkaz Director
vo_title_welcome.text: Welcome to the Sauin promo shoot! Places, everyone—New Era for the Myriad Souls!

vo_clapper_start.speaker: Sarkaz Director
vo_clapper_start.text: Quiet on set! Scene one, rolling—and action!

vo_tut_cast.speaker: Sarkaz Director
vo_tut_cast.text: Drag or tap one actor and one prop onto their stage marks, then roll camera!

vo_reshoot.speaker: Sarkaz Director
vo_reshoot.text: Cut, cut! Reset the props—let's try another take!

vo_album_open.speaker: Stage Narrator
vo_album_open.text: The Film Album! Replay your favorite takes and track all five Sauin endings.

vo_rewards_claim.speaker: Last Rite
vo_rewards_claim.text: Oh, thank you! Here are your Sauin studio rewards!

vo_all_complete.speaker: Sarkaz Director
vo_all_complete.text: Bravo, Director! Every single take and ending is in the can—an absolute masterpiece!

vo_s1_dlg_1.speaker: Mysterious Sarkaz
vo_s1_dlg_1.text: O most noble Sarkaz Princess! Where walk the Myriad Souls, Sauin must follow to guide them home—two halves bound by fate, forever inseparable!

vo_s1_dlg_2.speaker: Camille
vo_s1_dlg_2.text: Ahem. Operator Last Rite, the cameras are already rolling.

vo_s1_dlg_3.speaker: Last Rite
vo_s1_dlg_3.text: R-Rolling already?! Oh, I'm so sorry! Please, carry right on!

vo_s1_dlg_4.speaker: Mysterious Sarkaz
vo_s1_dlg_4.text: From Terra to Talos-II, farewells never cease for the Sarkaz... yet the Sauin festival that lights their way has faded from memory.

vo_s1_dlg_5.speaker: Mysterious Sarkaz
vo_s1_dlg_5.text: O noble heir of the Royal Court! A sacred duty rests upon your shoulders—reclaim Sauin! Bring back the festival!

vo_s1_dlg_6.speaker: Mysterious Sarkaz
vo_s1_dlg_6.text: Where walk the Myriad Souls... Sauin must shine again.

vo_s2_dlg_1.speaker: Sarkaz Director
vo_s2_dlg_1.text: Sponsor plug first—places, everyone! Princess, hit your mark and read the cue card!

vo_s2_dlg_2.speaker: Last Rite
vo_s2_dlg_2.text: Unbeatable value, enchanting deals—only at Witchcraft Hour!

vo_s3_dlg_1.speaker: Injured Landbreaker
vo_s3_dlg_1.text: Witchcraft Hour's Sauin Mega-Bonanza... gulp... huge discounts, unbeatable bargains...

vo_s3_dlg_2.speaker: Last Rite
vo_s3_dlg_2.text: How on earth did you convince an actual Landbreaker to film a holiday commercial?!

vo_s3_dlg_3.speaker: Rossi
vo_s3_dlg_3.text: Heh! A fang of the Wolfpack has plenty of ways to be persuasive!

vo_s4_dlg_1.speaker: Mi Fu
vo_s4_dlg_1.text: Huh? A film shoot? So you're the crew the boss mentioned? Wait—Sauin?

vo_s4_dlg_2.speaker: Last Rite
vo_s4_dlg_2.text: Y-Yes! Witchcraft Hour is also running a special Sauin promotional event...

vo_s4_dlg_3.speaker: Mi Fu
vo_s4_dlg_3.text: Hah? A promo sale? All this buildup, and you're pitching coupons right on the film set.

vo_s4_dlg_4.speaker: Last Rite
vo_s4_dlg_4.text: Um... I can even apply for an exclusive Patrol Squad discount for your whole team!

vo_s5_dlg_1.speaker: Last Rite
vo_s5_dlg_1.text: H-Hello there! Excuse me, are you... a fellow Sarkaz?

vo_s5_dlg_2.speaker: Last Rite
vo_s5_dlg_2.text: Oh—a Banshee! Might you be interested in celebrating Sauin?

vo_s5_dlg_3.speaker: Ardashir
vo_s5_dlg_3.text: ...No. I'm afraid you have the wrong person.

vo_s5_dlg_4.speaker: Last Rite
vo_s5_dlg_4.text: Ack—sorry, my mistake! Still... any interest in Sauin? The discounts are seriously huge...

vo_take_1_1.speaker: Stage Narrator
vo_take_1_1.text: Wearing a borrowed ritual mask, the shy Sarkaz Princess vows to bring Sauin home—once she stops apologizing to the props!

vo_take_1_2.speaker: Stage Narrator
vo_take_1_2.text: Forget ancient prophecies—the Sarkaz Princess discovers that sizzling roast steak summons departed appetites faster than any ritual!

vo_take_1_3.speaker: Stage Narrator
vo_take_1_3.text: Wait—since when was the Sarkaz Princess this suave?! Camille's brooding masked monologue turns the commercial into cinema!

vo_take_1_4.speaker: Stage Narrator
vo_take_1_4.text: Camille ignores the script entirely and turns Act One into a midnight cooking show. The crew is already lining up for seconds!

vo_take_2_1.speaker: Stage Narrator
vo_take_2_1.text: On Fangqu Street, the Sarkaz Princess comforts a weeping Pop Loong—sharing her very first Sauin candy under the neon lights.

vo_take_2_2.speaker: Stage Narrator
vo_take_2_2.text: The Sarkaz Princess arrived at Fangqu Street hunting for candy, only to interrogate a silent Lankybeast... Did it understand a single word?

vo_take_2_3.speaker: Stage Narrator
vo_take_2_3.text: Stand-in Princess Chen Qianyu teams up with Pop Loong for a dazzling Wuling sword-dance that showers the street in sweets!

vo_take_2_4.speaker: Stage Narrator
vo_take_2_4.text: Disaster on Fangqu Street! Chen Qianyu challenges the Lankybeast to a jumping contest, launching the prop crew into the hedges!

vo_take_3_1.speaker: Stage Narrator
vo_take_3_1.text: To reclaim the stolen candy and save Sauin, the Sarkaz Princess draws cold steel—though the Landbreaker looks more scared of forgetting his lines!

vo_take_3_2.speaker: Stage Narrator
vo_take_3_2.text: Instead of a blade, the Princess offers a giant swirl lollipop! Even the fiercest Landbreaker melts for Sauin sweetness.

vo_take_3_3.speaker: Stage Narrator
vo_take_3_3.text: Stunt-double Rossi steals the spotlight! With one flashy Wolfpack flourish, the Landbreaker surrenders every last piece of candy!

vo_take_3_4.speaker: Stage Narrator
vo_take_3_4.text: Wait a minute—Rossi uses the giant lollipop to extort both the Landbreaker and the film crew's snack table!

vo_take_4_1.speaker: Stage Narrator
vo_take_4_1.text: The Sarkaz Princess shares the recovered Candy Chest with the whole Patrol Squad—turning a late-night shift into a warm Sauin feast!

vo_take_4_2.speaker: Stage Narrator
vo_take_4_2.text: Boom! The Princess launches a sky full of Sauin fireworks over the outpost—even Witchcraft Hour couldn't buy better publicity!

vo_take_4_3.speaker: Stage Narrator
vo_take_4_3.text: The Sarkaz Princess—wait, Mi Fu?!—recovered the candy, while Captain Yvonne laughs maniacally on the chest... isn't she having way too much fun?!

vo_take_4_4.speaker: Stage Narrator
vo_take_4_4.text: Who aimed the fireworks indoors?! Rockets ricochet across the set while Mi Fu deadpans through absolute pyrotechnic pandemonium!

vo_take_5_1.speaker: Stage Narrator
vo_take_5_1.text: Beneath the silver gaze of Talos, the Sarkaz Princess lifts her mask—realizing Sauin lives wherever friends gather to remember.

vo_take_5_2.speaker: Stage Narrator
vo_take_5_2.text: Um, hello, Mister Talos? Last Rite tries dialing the moon on an Originium Suppressor, cracking up the entire studio!

vo_take_5_3.speaker: Stage Narrator
vo_take_5_3.text: Mistaken for royalty yet again, Ardashir contemplates the ancient mask beneath Talos—giving the finale unexpected mythic grandeur.

vo_take_5_4.speaker: Stage Narrator
vo_take_5_4.text: At last, the Sarkaz Princess found Talos! Orbiting high above Talos-II, why is a planetary-sized Suppressor bolted onto the moon?!

vo_end_1.speaker: Stage Narrator
vo_end_1.text: Ending One: Strange Sauin! Everyone got candy except the Sauin-exclusive Pop Loongs! Left empty-handed, the Pop Loong army chooses trick—marching on Seš'qa to take over Talos-II!

vo_end_2.speaker: Stage Narrator
vo_end_2.text: Ending Two: The Sauin Universe! Drawn together by earnest warmth, every corner of Talos-II lights a lantern for the myriad souls—and Last Rite nailed her final line!

vo_end_3.speaker: Stage Narrator
vo_end_3.text: Ending Three: An Unending Parade! The commercial spills off the stage into an all-night carnival down Fangqu Street while Witchcraft Hour sells out of every lollipop!

vo_end_4.speaker: Stage Narrator
vo_end_4.text: Ending Four: Sauin and Sarkaz! Talos whispers that Sauin shall endure as long as the Sarkaz do—while poor Ardashir sighs, for the tenth time, I am not a Sarkaz!

vo_end_5.speaker: Stage Narrator
vo_end_5.text: Ending Five: Sauin Never Exists! Smoke fills the stage, fireworks orbit the moon, and the Director tosses his megaphone—maybe Sauin was a glorious fever dream all along!
